results.name: drizzle-check
results.configuration: Explicit synthetic loopback port 1 URL; metadata check did not connect to any database.

dependencyChanges: Moved braces AST depth/node/width checks from root wrappers into compile/expand/stringify walker entry points, so direct submodule imports cannot bypass checks.
Scoped @esbuild-kit/core-utils@3.3.2 esbuild override to genuine published 0.25.12; preserved other esbuild/tsx versions and qs 6.16.0.
limits: No hosted provider, clinical data, deployment or hosted database was accessed by these checks.

frozenInstallFinal.installedPostImageIntegrity: All manifest hashes verified against actual pnpm-resolved files by security regression case 1.

repairHistory: A zero-context formatting-only patch attempt installed incorrectly through the pnpm patch parser; its ReferenceError was detected immediately by the security suite. The standard contextful patch was restored, frozen-installed, and all 22 security cases rerun successfully. No application code was changed for this transient failure.
commitCandidateBullets: Guard every braces AST walker entry, including direct submodule imports, and verify reviewed package hashes.
Replace the legacy Drizzle loader's vulnerable esbuild with the genuine parent-scoped 0.25.12 release; preserve qs 6.16.0 and other esbuild/tsx edges.
Add six security/compatibility cases covering direct walker entry, actual parent resolution, TypeScript transforms and dev-server CORS/Host protection.

Record independent unsuppressed production/full audits, registry availability, upstream tarball integrity and bounded exploit controls; retain the two HIGH release blockers until genuine fixed upstream releases are available.
patchArtifactWhitespace: Standard unified patch context lines contain a required leading context marker on otherwise empty lines. git diff --check flags the newly added patch artifact context; application/source changes are checked separately without weakening their whitespace checks. Keep the verified contextful format because the pnpm parser misapplies zero-context inserts.

esbuildRemediation.compatibility: Reviewed installed core-utils uses transformSync and transform, not the changed serve return API. Both transforms/source maps, real loopback CORS/Host checks and drizzle-kit check pass.
esbuildRemediation.limits: This is a reviewed cross-minor override for the legacy transformation-only caller; future loader upgrades must recheck the override.
